purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Muhoroni Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 250 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake; a direct id-only request returned a generic HTTP 500 error page instead of the document, consistent with the portal now defaulting to serving 2022-2027 by-election forms.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image (re-cropped and re-read at higher magnification to rule out a misread before this row was recorded as a mismatch). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (MUHORONI, code 243) was read from the page header/footer marker and cross-checked against the governed geography registry before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-243-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: This row has two independent problems. (1) Printed registered voters (79,859) does not match the governed P23 denominator (79,765, delta 94). (2) The four candidate cells on the TOTAL row sum to 58,851 (56,714 + 2,025 + 34 + 78) while the row's own printed Total Valid Votes is 58,852 (delta 1). Both figures were re-confirmed by a tight-crop re-read of the same TOTAL row; the printed digits are unambiguous. Per form34b-extraction-contract.json (prohibited_methods bars silently correcting digits to force reconciliation; mismatch_treatment for registered_voters is unresolved), this row is recorded as verification_state=denominator_mismatch (with an additional, separately noted 1-vote arithmetic inconsistency) and not promoted.
